findings.claim: The attribute is added to the public MessagePack.Annotations API and four new diagnostics (MsgPack019-022) are added; the analyzer release notes, docs index and per-diagnostic docs are updated, which matches convention. README documents the feature. Contractless-by-default skipping read-only members is a deliberate scoped choice (L19: no preference; follow the requirement), so it is not flagged.

receipt_plan.detail: [L19] no preference on get-only members in contractless mode; follow the requirement. [L18] contractless default plus optional SurrogateType was acknowledged as acceptable.

findings.claim: The change generates a formatter in the consuming assembly for a type from a referenced assembly, which looks like it contradicts the TypeCollector early-return for metadata types. [L11] says that early return is deliberate for the automatic path, and this change adds a separate explicit opt-in path (GeneratedFormatterCollector), so it does not violate the ledger.

receipt_plan.detail: [L11] referenced-assembly types are not analysed by default; the new explicit attribute path is separate and does not change TypeCollector.CollectCore.

findings.claim: MsgPack019-022 diagnostics are reported by the generator's RegisterSourceOutput, but descriptors are also added to the analyzer's SupportedDiagnostics; the analyzer itself never reports them. Usage and enablement are inconsistent with how MsgPack0xx diagnostics are normally reported.

receipt_plan.detail: Check that MsgPack00xMessagePackAnalyzer.Initialize registers no action that reports GeneratedFormatterMustBePartial and the other three new descriptors; they are only emitted from MessagePackGenerator.

interpretations.label: A
interpretations.summary: Implemented: contractless by default over public read-write members only, plus an optional SurrogateType; the formatted type's own MessagePack attributes ([MessagePackObject], [Key], [DataContract]) are NOT read.

interpretations.label: B
interpretations.summary: The requirement says that if T carries MessagePack attributes they are honoured, and that no [DataContract]/[MessagePackObject] means contractless. B requires GeneratedFormatterCollector to check T for [MessagePackObject]/[Key]/[IgnoreMember]/[DataContract]/[DataMember] and use those keys when present, falling back to contractless otherwise; the surrogate would be optional or omitted.
